name: Omni PGA Frisco Resort
positioning: Golf resort (officially Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa) on the 660-acre PGA Frisco campus, with two championship courses, a full-service spa and four pools
best_for: Golfers who want championship courses, a short course and a putting course on site
Families and golf groups wanting pools or a four-bedroom ranch house villa

facts.text: The resort sits on the 660-acre PGA Frisco campus, which also includes Fields Ranch, The PGA District, PGA of America and Northern Texas PGA.
PGA Frisco is a public/private partnership between the PGA of America, Omni Hotels & Resorts, the City of Frisco and the Frisco Independent School District.
Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa features two championship golf courses, a full-service spa and four pools.
Fields Ranch West is a Beau Welling-designed course encouraging shotmaking and creativity.
The Swing is a lighted 10-hole, par-3 short course for golfers of all skill levels.
PGA Frisco is the home of the 2027 PGA Championship.
The Ranch House Villas have chef kitchens, outdoor patios with fire pits and interiors filled with natural light.
The Leisure Pool Bar sits next to two pools and a splash pad.
Ice House is a ranch-style venue with BBQ from the pit and six live hitting bays.
Trick Rider is a Texas-style supper club specializing in steaks and seafood.
The Collective Green shop in the resort lobby carries brands such as Peter Millar, Greyson, Vuori and Holderness & Bourne.

highlights.text: Fields Ranch East is a Gil Hanse-designed course offering a strategic challenge.
The Dance Floor is a lighted two-acre putting course co-designed by Gil Hanse and Beau Welling.
The Ranch House Villas are four-bedroom villas designed as a modern take on the Texas ranch home.
Mokara Spa includes a sauna, a steam room and a private pool for spa guests.
Trick Rider's horseshoe-shaped bar sits under Cinnamon, a Swarovski crystal horse chandelier.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the resort is in suburban Frisco, so Dallas attractions require transportation.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
The resort is one part of a larger shared campus that also includes The PGA District and PGA of America.
